_doc: ELEM-S81 canonical legacy core recipes for gen_core_kit_legacy.py. Key = plan hard-core module (or plan_module). ref_tile from results/signoff_1024/inventory.json (bksel_q: the hk2l kit whose views closed; l5: the n32 kit at 1766568f01 = main's binding). Defaults: util = spec route.pd, CTS args of VQ r12, hold margin 15, fanout 24. 10-25 (S81-CORES/LEGACY): qbank_N/S + sstn_base566 ft1_pairs dropped: main RTL (dc23a738f / e7390b932) lands every station input in its own pin register (2 flops per bit, +1 cycle), so no one-station pair exists and canonical face_guard needs none. dsfd_rstg / ot_s81_sstn_payload536: relay2 (0c1b14693) 2-flop stations, suffix r2, no ft1_pairs. 10-26 (CORES-KITS/S81 HOLD): recipe io_hold sender_min = IO-HOLD option A (COORD 10-25 10:23) on vector input buses; qbank_S / cfg7_seq_bfp k26 GRT hold repairs hit RSZ-0060 on 100%/98% input-port -> landing-register endpoints under the flat -40 contract.
